instruction: A clean studio photograph, full shot. In an indoor studio with a plain white background, four cheerleaders perform a stunt. The blonde flyer (R2) stands on top, raising her right arm high in a cheer pose while keeping her left hand on her hip, smiling forward. Supporting her are the curly-haired base on the left (R11) in profile facing right, the brown-haired base in the center (R10) facing forward, and the dark-haired base on the right (R13) in profile facing left. The bases hold the flyer's legs securely. Bright, even studio lighting illuminates the scene.
